paite: Huaiziak in Khrist a thu kihilh ding a-om a, itna a kinep theihna ding a-om a, kha toh kithuahna, kilainatna leh kihehpihna a-omleh,
heading: Khrist Kingaihniamna
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

paite: huai lungsim mah pu in, hichibang itna mah nei unla, tup kibang leh lungsim khat nei in ka kipahna hon hihkimsak un.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

paite: Kikhenna ding leh kithupisakna ziak in bangmah hih kei un; lungsim niamlak in michih in ama sang in midang hoih sa zaw hen.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh in amah a ding kia en lou in, midang a leng en sam hen.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

paite: Khrist Jesu a om hiai lungsim nei le uchin:
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah Pathian bang a om hinapi in, Pathian toh kikim a om thil khiaklah ding in asep kei hi,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

paite: himahleh amah ahong ki- awngsak a, sikha bang in ahong om a, mihing bang geih in ahong piang hi.
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

paite: Huchi in mihing mel ahon pu a, ahong kingainiam a, si ding in thu ahon mang a, ahi, kros a sihna nangawn.
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in amah nakpitak in ahihlianta a, min laklak a min tungnungpen apeta hi;
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

paite: Jesu min a mi tengteng akhukdin a, van tung, leitung leh lei nuai a thil om tengteng leh,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

paite: lei tengteng in Jesu Khrist Pa Pathian thupina ding a Toupa ahi chih apuankhiak theihna ding un.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in, ka itte aw, ka om lai kia hilou a, ka om louh lai a leng thu na man theih tak mah bang un, lau leh ling kawm in na hotdamna chiat uh semkhia un;
heading: Aksite Bang A Tang
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

paite: ama lungtaina ding a noumau a hon utsak leh hon semsakpa Pathian ahi.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

paite: Dawngdawng lou leh phunphun lou in thil bangkim hih un;
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

paite: Khangthak gilou leh khial, alak ua khovel vak bang a na tennate lak uah Pathian ta gensiatbei leh siangthou,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

paite: hinna thu taklang na hihtheihna ding un; huai a kipan ke'n, Khrist ni ahong tun chiang a, athawn in ka semgim kei a, athawn in ka taigim kei ka chih ngamna ding in.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

paite: Ahi, na ginna thillat tung ua Pathian a dia buakkhiak a om ding na hi leng ka kipak a, na vek un ka hon kipahpih hi.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

paite: Huaiziak mah in, nou leng kipak unla; kei leng hon kipahpih un.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh na omdan uh ka theih a lungmuang a ka omtheihna ding in na kiang ua Timothi hon sawl pah Toupa Jesu ah ka lamen hi.
heading: Timothi
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

paite: Hichibang lungsim pu a, na hoihna ding uh awlmoh midang kuamah ka nei kei hi.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

paite: Jesu Khrist thilte zong lou in, avek un amau tuam chiat azong uhi.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh ama'n tuh ta in apa nna asep bang in tanchinhoih genzakna ah kei ahon seppih chih theihchetna amah ah na nei uhi.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

paite: Huaiziak in bangchi in ka om dia chih ka hon theihchet peuhpeuh chiang in amah hon sawlkhiak pah ka kilamen hi.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

paite: Himahleh keimah mah leng ka hong pah ding chih Toupa ah ka kilamen hi.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

paite: Himahleh ka sanggam leh seppih leh sepaihpih leh na taksapna ua gamtang leh sawltak Epaphroditas na kiang ua hon sawl kiphamoh ka sa hi;
heading: Epaphroditas
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

paite: na vek un ahon ngai mahmah a, adam louh thu na zak un, alungkham mahmah hi.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

paite: Si dektak in achina ngei a; himahleh Pathian in atung ah zahngaihna anei a; amah tung kia leng hilou in kei tung ah leng ahi sam a, huchi a lungkhamna ka neih sawnsawnlouhna ding in.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

paite: Huaiziak in amah ka hon sawl teitei hi, amah na muh chiang un ana kipahpih un, huchi a kei leng ka dah luatlouhna ding in.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

paite: Huaiziak in kipaktak in Toupa ah amah na kipahpih unla, hichibang mite ana ngaisang un;
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

paite: Khrist nasepna ah amah tuh ahong si dek a, kei a ding a na hihkimlouhte uh hon hihsak atupna lam ah ahinna akhuai dektak hi.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
